chief_falsifier.finding: All apparent positives can currently be explained by source availability, documentation changes, or metadata updates rather than predictive or executable advantage.

e202_followup.assessment: The public Kalshi weather endpoint is a research lead only. E202 did not establish concrete hourly market rules or settlement equivalence.

guards: No market edge inferred without point-in-time executable market data.
No TWC feed status assumed equivalent to Kalshi contract finality.

h7_revision_evidence.assessment: Prospective collection is operating, but the current sample is too small to establish or globally falsify H7. Metadata/payload changes are not treated as temperature revisions.

independent_reproducer.finding: No candidate passed the pre-build and falsification gates, so independent reproduction is not applicable this hour.

reasons: No contemporaneous executable pricing evidence tied to the weather signal.
Weather-index availability and documentation changes are not an edge.

algebra.finding: The routed combo evidence only establishes product/documentation availability and does not prove any payout identity with positive executable edge.

behavioral.finding: No hypothesis-specific behavioral evidence was routed.

informed_flow.finding: No point-in-time participant identity or flow dataset was available.

microstructure.finding: The routed evidence is generic Polymarket order-book documentation. No point-in-time executable orderbook snapshot or mispricing episode was supplied for this run.

scout.finding: General venue/regulatory/documentation changes were found, but no new edge candidate survived semantic review.

settlement.finding: Settlement-source documentation is relevant, but exact live market-rule metadata was not resolved by E202. The public Kalshi weather endpoint exists, yet its relation to contract settlement/finality is unproven.

weather_twc.finding: Official Kalshi weather guidance again supports TWC as the settlement source for hourly temperature markets, but this run contains no out-of-sample evidence that a model predicts the final TWC value better than baselines.
